evals.prompt: Migrate Ant Design Button into this shadcn + Tailwind v4 project with 1:1 current public API compatibility. Deprecated props should be identified and recorded as not migrated by default.
evals.expected_output: Produces a source-backed compatibility contract, classifies Button as a primitive facade, preserves current props/types/events/ref/native passthrough, maps Ant style branches to target-owned Tailwind v4 tokens, writes type/render/behavior/style tests, records deprecated API decisions, and closes the acceptance checklist.

assertions.text: Reports Migration blocked unless a fresh-context independent verifier subagent report exists before final completion.
Records side-branch audit ownership for applicable source/API, style, demo, browser, contract, and learning-regression risks.
Rejects self-certified checklist pass rows by requiring verifier attribution and source-backed evidence.

evals.prompt: Migrate Ant Design Select into this shadcn + Tailwind v4 project. Preserve API, controlled/uncontrolled behavior, semantic DOM hooks, keyboard/focus behavior, popup behavior, and docs demos.
evals.expected_output: Inspects Ant and rc Select sources, target shadcn/Radix constraints, ConfigProvider defaults, portal/z-index behavior, keyboard and IME behavior, classNames/styles slots, docs demo parity, no Ant CSS leakage, browser assertions, and learning regression closure.

assertions.text: Spawns or requires a fresh-context independent verifier subagent for popup, keyboard, portal, and demo parity claims before completion.
Delegates applicable side-branch audits and merges findings into contract rows, tests, or blockers.
Fails completion when checklist rows have implementation-only evidence or missing verifier attribution.

evals.prompt: Migrate an Ant Design layout component such as Timeline or Steps into this shadcn + Tailwind v4 project, preserving docs demo behavior and visual geometry without using Ant CSS.
evals.expected_output: Treats layout styling as behavioral source, copies docs demos as fixtures, traces delegated/shared primitives, records positioning and containing-block matrices, preserves pixel token units, asserts connector/marker/slot geometry in browser tests, isolates viewer shell CSS, and blocks completion if any applicable checklist item is missing.

assertions.text: Requires an independent verifier subagent to falsify docs demo parity, connector endpoint, containing-block, and viewer-shell checklist passes.
Adds false-pass prevention assertions that would fail for the visible layout mismatch class being fixed.
Blocks completion when visual pass evidence is only screenshot or implementer-authored checklist status.

Requires a layout and visual ownership matrix covering flex/min-size, variant branch behavior, connector status source, CSS variable ownership, responsive ownership, and attached visual envelopes when applicable.

evals.prompt: Migrate Ant Design Modal or Drawer into this shadcn + Tailwind v4 project with Ant-compatible public API, portal behavior, z-index behavior, focus management, and accessibility.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the component as a Radix behavior component, inspects ConfigProvider and portal/container behavior, preserves open/defaultOpen and callback timing, verifies ESC/Tab/focus order and a11y, records runtime warning decisions, checks no Ant CSS leakage, and reports browser evidence with fallback reason when needed.

assertions.text: Requires independent verifier subagent evidence for portal, z-index, focus, and browser-visible behavior before final acceptance.
Records side-branch audit outputs for source behavior, portal geometry, a11y, warning decisions, and contract closure.
Marks Migration blocked when verifier findings are unresolved or checklist rows lack verifier attribution.
